name: Strength Level
scope: Dated reference snapshot. 1RM weights in pounds, dumbbells per hand. Pull Ups, Dips and Chin Ups use the explicitly labelled added-weight 1RM tables, not rep-count tables. Neutral Grip Pull Ups use regular Pull Ups weight standards as a proxy. Percentiles use linear interpolation of 5, 20, 50, 80, 95 anchors; they are estimates, not exact population percentiles.

updates.scope: Separate provisional iso-lateral family tiers from Stronger, not Strength Level percentile anchors.
Dedicated male/female 1RM tables by bodyweight, pounds per dumbbell.
